material_findings.canon_label_hint: Assistant memory versus stateful system-prompt loop contradiction
exact_items: `assistant-memory-subsystem.md` forbids Orchestrator memory via `NullMemoryProvider`, while `newfeatures.md` assumes a stateful system-prompt loop carrying execution state.
`chain-wizard-flexibility.md` still allows an explicit no-worktrees mode, while `WorktreeGitImprovement.md` still treats per-subtask worktrees as mandatory isolation.

material_findings.canon_label_hint: Tier-scoped approval gates lack package/seam completion model
exact_items: Approval/gate docs remain tier-scoped: `human-in-the-loop.md` and `Progression_Gates.md` still key boundaries to phase/task/subtask completion, with no canonical package-complete or seam-complete gate model.
notes: Current merged seed covers adjacent HITL identity/boundary and Progression_Gates wiring issues, but does not already represent the specific missing package-complete/seam-complete gate canon across both docs with equal or stronger evidence.
